parent_objective: implement a no-training source-balanced temporal command-response wave

public_gates: runner writes pair proposals before selected-pair temporal rollouts
selected pair proposals obey per-seed and per-fault-family caps
summary reports source-balance metrics and temporal action/outcome metrics separately
sentinel rows and sentinel false-positive rate are written
actor update PPO and promotion remain blocked
forbidden_shortcuts: do not simply raise max_pairs without quotas
do not treat action-only rows as outcome proof
do not add hidden fault labels or oracle values to actor observations

workflow_synthesis.evidence_axis: G_source_coverage: implement source-balanced temporal command-response data generation
workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: runs a no-training source-balanced temporal wave that avoids M719 early-seed saturation
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: diagnostic data wave only; source export objective design PPO and promotion remain blocked unless audited later
stop_condition: stop if sentinel false positives exceed threshold
stop if temporal action rows remain too sparse
stop if actor checksum or input contract changes
fallback_plan: if source-balanced temporal action rows are diverse, audit before boundary mining
if source-balanced temporal outcome rows are diverse, audit before source export or objective design
if temporal rows remain sparse, design sequence-level interventions
if source balance is blocked by current model coverage, design a dynamics-fidelity branch
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M724 admits no-training source-balanced temporal wave implementation

hypothesis: A no-training source-balanced temporal wave can remove M719/M722 source concentration and produce source-diverse temporal action rows for the next outcome-boundary audit.
success_criteria: M725 implements source-balanced pair proposal and selection
M725 reports source-balance and sentinel metrics
M725 keeps action and outcome evidence separate
no training PPO actor update or promotion occurs
failure_criteria: runner selects pairs in seed order until max_pairs is reached
runner combines action-only and outcome-positive claims
runner starts optimizer training PPO or checkpoint promotion

commands.command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH=src python -m autodrift.source_balanced_temporal_wave --checkpoint runs/m568_scaled_l3_bc_seed5660/checkpoint.pt --config configs/extreme_fault_coverage_v2_scenarios.json --seed-start 72000 --seed-count 512 --selected-pair-count 4096 --per-seed-pair-cap 8 --device cpu --run-dir runs/m725_source_balanced_temporal_wave
